description: MainActivity.kt defines the main screen of an Android notes app, displaying a list of notes with search functionality and options to add or edit notes.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity serves as the home screen of the app, displaying notes with search and create functionalities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting up toolbar, RecyclerView, adapter, floating action button, and loading notes.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes the notes list when the activity resumes.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from the repository, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu and sets up search view listeners.
